turns.reply:
I solved level 5 in 143 actions. The human baseline is 189, so the cost is below baseline.

How the game works, as far as I can tell:
- There are three line shapes: an X, a plus, and a diamond.
- Actions 1-4 move the active shape by 3 cells.
- Action 5 switches to the next shape. A 0 marks the center of the active shape. The order in which 5 selects shapes was not always what I expected.
- To win, each small 3x3 box must be crossed by a shape whose color matches the color in the middle of that box.
- A shape takes a new color when its lines touch the big corner box of that color.

What worked:
1. I wrote a short search over all shape positions. It found only one layout that covers all ten boxes.
2. I moved each shape to its place in that layout.
3. I moved the diamond to touch the 8 corner, then the X and the plus to touch the 9 corner. After each touch, I moved the shape back to its place.

About 50 of my actions went to trial and error before I understood the color rule.

I saved these rules as a global memory (`arc-d5dc1d3f-rules`), so later instances of this game can use them.
